source_of_truth: KlausBook-Context/docs/reference/design-tokens.json is canonical. A byte-identical copy lives at the same relative path in klaus-note-addon. After editing this file in either repo, run scripts/check-token-sync.sh (in either repo) to diff the two copies, then copy the change across.

status.colors: Implemented by KlausBook's extensions/klaus-pdf/webview-src/viewer.css today (:root = dark, body.vscode-light = light). This is the TARGET palette for klaus_note/theme.py, not yet implemented there — board card KB-012 ('klaus_note: re-skin library + viewer to the Obsidian look') is the work of porting klaus_note's palette() from its old Quiet Clinic tokens (see klaus_note DESIGN.md, pre-KB-012) to these values, and updating DESIGN.md's frontmatter to match.
status.highlightInks: Implemented identically today in both: klaus_note/theme.py HIGHLIGHT_INKS and KlausBook's extensions/klaus-pdf/webview-src/highlights.ts HIGHLIGHT_INKS. These deliberately never theme-fork (light/dark/accent) because they bake into the PDF's own annotation color.
status.typeScale_radii: klaus_note's existing scale (DESIGN.md 'Scale-Or-Drift Rule', enforced there by tests/test_theme.py scanning emitted QSS). KlausBook does not yet validate against this scale — treat as the target scale for any new KlausBook UI, not yet an enforced contract there.
